reported.title: No debounce and wrong edge polarity: presses toggle multiple times and releases toggle
reported.description: The loop has no settle window at all: line 52 reads the pin and line 54 immediately acts on it, so contact bounce on press and release is counted as multiple edges (measured 2-3 toggles per press in the rapid and bounce scenarios, e.g. press at 800 ms toggled D13 2 times). The edge detector at line 28 only fires on LOW-to-HIGH (risingEdge), which is the release edge, not the active-LOW press edge, so presses are missed (0 toggles for the press at 1.00 s in the bounce-on-release scenario) and releases cause spurious toggles (9-16 unexplained toggles, first at 952 ms). The 40 ms settle requirement is never implemented anywhere in the firmware. 15 of 15 press(es) did not toggle D13 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [2, 2, 3, 2, 2, 3, 3, 2, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2]. D13 also toggled 9 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 952 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Panel key on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); status LED on D13.
- Each settled press toggles D13 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Use a 40 ms settle window before accepting a press edge (HIGH-to-LOW after settle).
- Print `panel led=<0|1> edges=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Idle (unpressed) key reads HIGH.
